decisions.scriptoriumVerseTranslation: Therefore, I tell you, don't be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn't life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

discrepancies.scriptoriumVerseTranslation: He said to them, 'I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,
discrepancies.hornerEnglish: Said he to them, With a desire I desired to eat this Paskha with you before I die.
